prompt_text: A futuristic underwater research station during a systems emergency — alarms pulsing, bubbling water pressure against the hull, crew radio chatter, generator hum, distant sonar pings, emergency lighting flicker represented as a low electrical hum

elements.label: Alarm Pulsing
elements.prompt: Beeping, metal control panel, continuous, cramped control room, close, bright

elements.label: Water Pressure
elements.prompt: Hissing, water against steel hull, continuous, dark corridor outside laboratory, distant, muffled

elements.label: Crew Radio Chatter
elements.prompt: Voiced shouting, comms device, sparse, central communication hub, close, soft

elements.label: Generator Hum
elements.prompt: Rumbling, electrical generator, continuous, narrow alleyway with power conduits, close, dry

elements.label: Sonar Pings
elements.prompt: Distant beeping, sonar equipment, occasional, dark research laboratory, distant, reverberant

elements.label: Emergency Lighting Flicker
elements.prompt: Dissonant ambient drone, cold, sustained low tone in minor key, slow, 40 BPM, sparse and reverberant, instrumental, no vocals
